sources.entry: DDR5MDB02 Multiplexed Rank Data Buffer, JESD82-552 - Defines the data buffer behind MRDIMMs, whose vendor bandwidth claims name no method, pending a run against RDIMMs.

summary.title: DDR5MDB02 Multiplexed Rank Data Buffer (JESD82-552)
summary.one_liner: JEDEC standard JESD82-552 defines the DDR5MDB02 data buffer that drives DQ and DQS nets on DDR5 MRDIMM modules.
takeaways: JESD82-552 is the JEDEC standard defining the DDR5MDB02 logic device, a data buffer for DDR5 MRDIMM modules.
The DDR5MDB02 drives the DQ and DQS nets on MRDIMM applications.
The standard covers features, functionality, DC and AC interface parameters, and test loading.
The document was published February 2026 by committee JC-40.4.
Full text is a free download but requires registration or login; RAND license forms are for JEDEC members.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for JEDEC standard JESD82-552, published February 2026 by committee JC-40.4. The standard specifies features, functionality, DC and AC interface parameters, and test loading for the DDR5MDB02 data buffer used to drive DQ and DQS nets on DDR5 MRDIMM modules. The stated purpose is uniformity and multiple sources for the logic device. The page text itself contains no technical details beyond this scope; the full document is a free download behind registration or login.
